commands.cmd: set -euo pipefail; root="$PWD"; rustup update stable
probe=$(mktemp -d /tmp/cx-m10-native-cut-artifacts.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$probe"' EXIT; mkdir -p src out
write probe src/main.rs, copy Cargo.lock, write probe Cargo.toml
for case in k04..k11 (8 fixtures): cargo +stable run -j4 --manifest-path probe/Cargo.toml -- probe/out fixture
steps=(probe/out/*.step); if none: print occt_not_run_because_no_step_answer=true; exit case_status
commands.status: exit 0 (this branch was taken, script ended here)

commands.cmd: python3 -m venv probe/occt; pip install cadquery-ocp==8.0.1.1.0; OCP raw and standard-reader STEP checks

notes: No cargo test lines in run.log (script runs a probe binary, not cargo test). All 8 cases printed answer_step_bytes_work_and_refusal_match_all_threads=true. Every case hit the 20000000 operation cap (exhausted=true, work 19926846 to 19999976) and returned refusal numbers.operation-budget, so no STEP bytes were produced. The script printed occt_not_run_because_no_step_answer=true and exited 0 before the OpenCASCADE validation, so no STEP artifacts were checked. cargo fetch ran before the script and downloaded crates without error. rustc 1.100.0.
